blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Chinese e-commerce platform Temu has agreed to cooperate with the Philippines’ campaign to rid online marketplaces of counterfeit goods. Temu signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL), which leads government efforts to protect intellectual property rights and combat counterfeiting and piracy.
